UNDER_REVIEW.label: Begin the review
UNDER_REVIEW.consequence: Freezes the three declarations above: from now on, a change means a new version. Results stay provisional until a decision is recorded.
UNDER_REVIEW.confirmHeading: Confirm: begin the review of version {version} of {method}

APPROVED.label: Approve
APPROVED.consequence: Results scored under this version count: they are published instead of provisional.
APPROVED.finality: To reverse an approval later, the version has to be rejected or withdrawn, with a published reason.

REJECTED.label: Reject
REJECTED.consequence: The version is published as failed, with your rationale, and cannot produce results. Results it already produced are withdrawn with it.
REJECTED.finality: This is final: a rejected version cannot be reviewed again. A fix means a new version.

WITHDRAWN.label: Withdraw
WITHDRAWN.consequence: The version is taken out of use and cannot produce results. Results it already produced are withdrawn with it, and the reason is published.
WITHDRAWN.finality: This is final: a withdrawn version cannot be reviewed again.

rejectAfterApproval.label: Reject after approval
rejectAfterApproval.consequence: Revokes the approval. The version is published as failed, with your rationale, and results already published under it are withdrawn.

reviewIntro: Read the three declarations above first. Your decision and its rationale are published on this page, for everyone, as soon as you confirm.
withdrawIntro: You submitted this method, so you can withdraw a version of it. You cannot review it: review is in pairs.
rationaleHint: Published with the decision. Give the verdict, the class of any finding, and the reasoning that makes the verdict checkable. Never exploit code, parameter values or patient-level data.
noteHint: Beginning a review decides nothing, so a note is optional. If you write one, it is published.
replacesPrevious: It replaces the rationale published now.
confirmLead: Check before you confirm. Nothing is recorded until you do.
rationaleRequired: Write the rationale: it is published with the decision.
rationaleTooShort: Write at least 10 characters: the rationale has to make the decision checkable.
forbidden: The platform refused this decision. Review is in pairs: whoever submitted the method or declared this version cannot review it, and only an evaluation reviewer can record an outcome. Nothing was changed; your text is kept below.
stale: Version {version} is now {status}: a decision was recorded while you were writing. Nothing was changed by you; the page shows the version as it is now, and your text is kept below.
notReviewable: Version {version} is {status}, which does not allow this decision. Nothing was changed; your text is kept below.
rationaleRefused: The platform requires a rationale for this decision.
gone: This method or version no longer exists. Nothing was recorded.
unreachable: The platform could not be reached. Nothing was recorded; try again.
failed: The decision could not be recorded (error {status}). Nothing was changed; your text is kept below.
noLongerOpen: No decision is open to you on this version any more. Your text is kept below:
barredSubmitted: You submitted this method, so you cannot review it. Review is in pairs: another evaluation reviewer records the decision.
barredDeclared: You declared this version, so you cannot review it. Review is in pairs: another evaluation reviewer records the decision.
recordedBanner: Recorded: version {version} is now {status}. The decision and its rationale are published below.
declaredBanner: Version {version} is declared. It is now waiting for an evaluation reviewer.
reviewRecordHint: Only the latest decision and its rationale are shown. The platform’s audit trail keeps every step.
permissionsUnavailable: Your permissions on this method could not be read just now, so no review or declaration form is shown. Reload the page to try again.
